scope: Prompt-engineering reference for local LLM use only.

pws_assisted_prompt_tools.name: structured_pws_context
pws_assisted_prompt_tools.description: A minimal JSON context containing one eligible date, component scores, deterministic weights, coverage and guardrail limits.

pws_assisted_prompt_tools.name: bounded_weight_delta_response
pws_assisted_prompt_tools.description: The only allowed output mechanism. Returns no_adjustment or proposed deltas for LQ, REC, CAP and VS.

pws_assisted_prompt_tools.name: no_adjustment_fallback
pws_assisted_prompt_tools.description: Required fallback when no bounded, evidence-backed redistribution is justified.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: dashboard_health
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Checks whether the local read-only dashboard API is available.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: snapshot_status
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Returns current snapshot readiness, latest data date and primary score status.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: snapshot_manifest
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Returns current snapshot metadata and lineage identifiers.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: dashboard_payload
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Returns the complete local dashboard payload when a full read-only view is needed.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: dashboard_current_state
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Returns current deterministic PWS, optional assisted variant, readiness, components, weights and load metrics.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: dashboard_time_series
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Returns already computed time-series values for charting and read-only explanation.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: dashboard_quality
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Returns coverage, missing-data and quality information already produced by upstream modules.

user_conversation_prompt_tools.name: dashboard_disclosures
user_conversation_prompt_tools.description: Returns disclaimers and interpretation limits for the dashboard.
